name: a4988-carrier-socket
description: Board-side 2x8 female socket footprint for Pololu A4988 stepper motor driver carrier

provenance.source: Pololu 1182 carrier page and dimension diagram 0J1082

watch_out_for: This is a board-side mating interface, not a single manufacturer-orderable part or an A4988 IC land pattern. Populate two 1x08 female headers 15.24 mm apart for the 15.2 x 20.3 mm carrier. No manufacturer part number is claimed for this composite footprint.
